In this boxing adventure game, players navigate through lively crowds to reach the ring. Within a set time limit, they must strike punching pads to score points and advance to the next level. The game features a playful 'Happy Bear' target that reacts with various animations upon impact, delivering authentic boxing feedback for a truly immersive experience



>> Features of Happy Bear Boxing:


  • Lively Game Environment: Navigate through dynamic crowds and reach the boxing ring, creating an exciting and immersive experience.

  • Punching Pad Interaction: Players must strike specific punching pads to earn points, with the speed and accuracy of the punches determining the score.

  • Playful "Happy Bear" Target: The "Happy Bear" reacts with animated expressions and movements when struck, adding a playful and rewarding element to the game.

  • Authentic Boxing Feedback: The game provides responsive and realistic feedback for every punch, making players feel as if they’re really in the ring.

  • Time Limit Challenges: Players have a set time to score points, which adds a sense of urgency and excitement to each round.

  • Level Progression: As players advance, the challenges increase in difficulty, offering a fun and engaging progression system.

  • Family-Friendly: The cartoonish and light-hearted nature of the game makes it ideal for players of all ages, from children to adults.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Happy Bear Boxing:


Fun and Engaging Exercise: A great way to combine physical activity with fun, promoting hand-eye coordination and reflex training while offering a full-body workout.


Stress Relief: Punching pads and the playful target system provide an enjoyable way to release stress and energy.


Entertainment for All Ages: With its easy-to-learn mechanics and entertaining visuals, Happy Bear Boxing is perfect for family gatherings, kids’ parties, or team-building events.

Interactive Game for Fitness Centers: Ideal for fitness centers, entertainment venues, or home setups, where users can enjoy an energetic workout with a fun twist.


Competitive Play: The time-limited challenges and scoring system allow for friendly competition between players, making it perfect for group or multiplayer scenarios.



>> Product Number: LJST032


  • Floor area: 1m*1.5m*2.5m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3-10 minutes

  • Power: 130w



>> FAQs for Happy Bear Boxing:


Q1: How do I play Happy Bear Boxing?

A1: In this game, you navigate through a lively crowd to reach the boxing ring. Once there, you strike specific punching pads within a time limit to score points. The playful "Happy Bear" target reacts with animations when hit, making the experience even more engaging.


Q2: Is Happy Bear Boxing suitable for kids?

A2: Yes, Happy Bear Boxing is designed to be fun and family-friendly, with cartoonish visuals and easy-to-understand gameplay. It’s perfect for kids, but also enjoyable for adults.


Q3: What is the "Happy Bear" target?

A3: The "Happy Bear" is a fun, animated character that reacts with different animations when struck by a punch. It adds an element of fun and rewards players for their accuracy and timing.


Q4: Can I play alone or with others?

A4: You can play alone or challenge friends and family in a competitive setting. The game’s scoring system allows players to compete against each other, making it perfect for multiplayer fun.


Q5: How can I track my progress in the game?

A5: The game features a level progression system where you advance to higher levels by scoring points and completing challenges within the time limit. The faster and more accurately you strike the punching pads, the more points you earn.
